sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 274413 (search/campsites API, read 2026-10-28)

values.note: $20 a site, up to 10 people and 2 vehicles; group sites (D9, D11, G24) $40-50. $8 non-refundable reservation fee per reservation. Same rates all year in recreation.gov's 2024-2028 tables.

fees.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/north-fruita-desert-campground ('Campsite rates are $20 per night and include up to 10 people and 2 vehicles. There is an $8 non-refundable reservation fee for each reservation.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274413/rates (2026-2028 Peak and Non-Peak: StandardSite 20, group types 40/50), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/north-fruita-desert-campground ('At both the upper and lower units there no water, electricity, or garbage collection service'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Two units 1.5 mi apart on 18 Road: the Upper Campground (58 sites incl. group sites D9, D11; graveled spurs, no tent pads) and the Lower Campground (53 sites incl. group site G24, 12x12 tent pads) at the trailhead and event staging area, where some sites may close during races and festivals. Site sizes vary - check the dimensions before booking; many pull-throughs, a few spurs as short as 20 ft. 10 people and 2 vehicles a site.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/north-fruita-desert-campground ('The Upper Campground contains 58 campsites'; 'The Lower Campground contains 53 campsites'; 'The site size and parking capacity vary, so be sure to check site dimensions before making a reservation'; 'During events, some campsites may be closed') + catalog 274413 (RV/trailer equipment lengths to 80 ft at B12 and F01; Pull-through sites throughout; three 99-ft values at G07/G15/G22 carry no equipment list and were not used), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No water, electricity or trash service - bring water and pack out all trash (dog waste included). Bring firewood; no gathering. Volunteer host in spring and fall at the north end of the upper campground.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/north-fruita-desert-campground ('Vault toilets are within walking distance of the campsites'; 'there no water, electricity, or garbage collection service'; 'no firewood collection is allowed'; 'We try to have a volunteer campground host on site during the spring and fall seasons') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274413 (notice 'All trash, including dog waste, must be packed out'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservations are required for all camping. Sites A1-A14, B1-B12, G1-G23, H1-H5, J5-J7, K8-K15 and the group sites book up to six months ahead; C, D, E, F, J1-J4 and K1-K7 open only four days before arrival. Changes until 24 hours before; you cannot change the check-in date.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274413 (notices 'available for reservation up to six months in advance ... Sites A1 through A14 ...'; 'available for reservation up to four days in advance of your stay: Sites C1-C21 ...'; 'Reservations are required for all camping within the campground'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14) + https://www.blm.gov/visit/north-fruita-desert-campground ('Camping is limited to 14 days'; 'you cannot change your check-in date'), read 2026-10-28

note: BLM (Grand Junction Field Office) campground at the 18 Road (North Fruita Desert) mountain-bike trail system, ~7-8.5 mi north of Fruita at the foot of the Book Cliffs, among scattered juniper with wide views of the Grand Valley. Ride to the trails from the campsites; the Lower Campground doubles as an event staging area. Hot in summer, sparse shade. --Claude
